Road traffic incidents and roadworks on the Scottish trunk road and motorway network.

Contains Traffic Scotland data (DATEX II feeds: unplanned events and current roadworks), updated when the app starts and then every hour.

Roadworks are colour coded by the delays they cause:
green = no delays reported
amber = delays
red = long delays
purple = very long delays

Maps: Google Maps SDK for Android.
